# LYGG Attends WindEnergy Hamburg


Jaa artikkeli:


11.09.2026


News


WindEnergy Hamburg, 22–25 September! Come to meet our team: Katja Vainio, Maria Hamminga and Roope Kekäläinen at the Emden Airport stand.


📍 Hall B5 | Booth 402.2


We have some great news to share and plenty to talk about when it comes to connecting the North Sea region.


Come by, meet the team and hear what’s next for LYGG.


See you in Hamburg!
